stem:
Komal picks small stones out of uncooked rice, and she collects cream while churning milk for butter.

What is true about these separations?

options.text: Picking stones removes an unwanted part; churning collects a useful part.
Both actions only remove unwanted parts.
Both actions are only stirring food, so they are not separations.
Picking stones collects a useful part; churning removes an unwanted part.

teacher.key_rationale: Separation can remove an unwanted part or collect a useful part.
